title: Her Smell
description: Becky Something is a talented but self-destructive musician who seems determined to alienate everyone around her -- even at the cost of her own band's success.

title: Prison on Fire 2
description: Ching escapes from prison to see his young son who has been put in an orphanage.

title: The Company of Wolves
description: An innocent girl (Sarah Patterson) meets wolves and werewolves in fantasies echoing the tale of Little Red Riding Hood.

title: Paris Is Burning
description: Filmmaker Jennie Livingston shows New York clubs where gay men enter posing contests, called "voguing."

title: Agent Red
description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility.

title: Candy
description: A fatherly chemistry professor indulges two young lovers in their ever-increasing heroin habits as his life spins out of control.

title: The Exorcist III
description: A police detective (George C. Scott) investigates a series of slayings done in the style of an executed killer (Brad Dourif).

title: Jiminy Glick in Lalawood
description: A celebrity interviewer (Martin Short) and his wife (Jan Hooks) become tangled in a murder mystery involving a boozy actress, her family and her publicist.

title: Dawg
description: In order to inherit $1 million, a heartless womanizer (Denis Leary) must seek forgiveness from his former conquests.

title: Sisters
description: A small-time reporter tries to convince the police she saw a murder in the apartment across from hers.

title: Q: The Winged Serpent
description: A fleeing gangland flunky (Michael Moriarty) finds the New York nest of Aztec deity Quetzalcoatl, the man-eating flying serpent.

title: Dead Ringers
description: Twin-brother gynecologists (Jeremy Irons) are divided by a patient (Geneviève Bujold) and doomed by drugs.

title: Bodyguards and Assassins
description: In 1906 Hong Kong, a newspaper editor and a tycoon learn of an assassination plot against Sun Yat-sen, and recruit a small band of ordinary men and women to protect him.

title: My Best Fiend
description: Filmmaker Werner Herzog narrates an exploration of his love-hate relationship with actor Klaus Kinski.

title: Sea Fever
description: A marine biology student and other crew members fight for survival when an unfathomable life-form attacks their fishing trawler.

title: The Bat
description: A mystery writer (Agnes Moorehead) and her friends are stalked by a faceless throat-ripper (Vincent Price) in a haunted house.

title: Clockwatchers
description: Friendship helps make nightmarish office jobs bearable for four young women working as temporary employees.

title: Fong Sai-Yuk II
description: A man (Jet Li) dominated by his martial-artist mother (Josephine Hsiao) joins an anti-Manchu society led by a mysterious godfather (Adam Cheng).

title: Studio 666
description: Legendary rock band Foo Fighters move into an Encino mansion steeped in grisly rock and roll history to record their much anticipated 10th album.

title: Gerry
description: After stopping their car for a hike, two men (Casey Affleck, Matt Damon) get lost in the desert without food or water.

title: Capricorn One
description: The first manned flight to Mars is a flop, so a space official (Hal Holbrook) fakes it Hollywood-style for the public.

title: The Blackout: Invasion Earth
description: Life on Earth is rapidly destroyed except for a small area in Eastern Europe.

title: Rosewater
description: While covering an election protest in 2009 Iran, BBC journalist Maziar Bahari is arrested, imprisoned and tortured for nearly four months.

title: Unlawful Entry
description: A creepy policeman (Ray Liotta) gets close to a Los Angeles couple (Kurt Russell, Madeleine Stowe) in order to drive them apart.

title: Black Christmas
description: Sorority sisters (Olivia Hussey, Margot Kidder) and their drunken housemother fall prey to an obscene yuletide caller.

title: Man of the Year
description: Tom Dobbs (Robin Williams), the satirical host of a political talk show, runs for U.S. president and unexpectedly wins.

title: Blind Horizon
description: An injured man (Val Kilmer) who cannot remember the past thinks he is involved in a plot to assassinate the president.

title: Plan 9 From Outer Space
description: Filmmaker Ed Wood Jr.'s laughable tale of alien invaders and resurrected corpses in the San Fernando Valley.

title: Guardians
description: A team of former Soviet superheroes, assembled during the Cold War to combat a dangerous scientist, is dispatched against destructive robots.

title: Nightbreed: Director's Cut
description: A young man's quest to end his nightmares leads him to a cemetery where monsters have retreated to escape mankind.

title: M
description: Fritz Lang's classic tells of the Berlin underworld's efforts to capture the loathsome murderer of a child.

title: Jesus of Nazareth
description: After Joseph and Mary's betrothal, Mary is visited by the angel Gabriel, who tells her she will bear the Son of God; Mary and Joseph travel to Bethlehem to take part in Herod's census, where Jesus is born.

title: Cobra Verde
description: A Brazilian plantation owner sends an employee (Klaus Kinski) to West Africa to re-establish a slave network.

title: Karate Killer
description: Kiba is back again, but this time he has fallen from grace and been sent to prison for all the violent acts he has committed. Once he's out, he begins working as a bodyguard in a club that is crawling with gangsters.

title: Snake and Crane Arts of Shaolin
description: Hsu Yiu Fong (Jackie Chan) guards a powerful book against numerous clans after the eight Shaolin masters who wrote it go missing.

title: Big Fan
description: A football fan (Patton Oswalt) meets his idol in a New York strip club, where his rabid devotion is put to the test and events take a suddenly violent turn.

title: The Eagle Has Landed
description: A Nazi colonel (Robert Duvall) drops a colonel (Michael Caine), a task force and an Irishman (Donald Sutherland) into England to kidnap Winston Churchill.

title: Elegy
description: A beautiful student (Penélope Cruz) throws into disarray the life of an aging lecturer and cultural critic (Ben Kingsley) when she awakens in him feelings of sexual possessiveness.

title: Escape to Athena
description: A Greek partisan (Telly Savalas) helps Allied prisoners escape with ancient art from a German major's (Roger Moore) island prison.

title: Chopping Mall
description: Eight teens are trapped in a shopping mall with three security robots out of control.

title: Jesus of Nazareth
description: Jesus' teachings and miracles draw large crowds.
